2. Mustard: Mustard is an important oilseed crop that is well-suited for Haryana's conditions. It is also a rabi crop and requires relatively less water. Mustard can be a good crop to include in your rotation to improve soil health.

5. Maize: Maize is emerging as an important crop in Haryana due to growing demand from the poultry feed industry. With your openness to tech, you could explore using hybrid seeds and mechanized harvesting to boost maize productivity.
